meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Streema's app and promo sections; trending chips, logos (blur/hide), genre grids, footer
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless) on the Streema home page with iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA, DOM captured after 7 seconds (Nuxt app; the two captures are the same markup). Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts (text stripped, needed ancestors only, `data-keep` on the main content and the hero search box).

LIVE: `.cookie-consent-banner` 1 (role=region, aria-label Cookie consent; the original cookie rule did not match it, so it was appended to that rule), the app-section rule (a section with App Store links that does not contain the hero search; the hero has badges too) 1, `#main-content section:has(aside)` 1 (the ratings block), `#main-content section:has(a[href$="/request"])` 1, `[data-testid="trending-chip"]` 5, `#main-content img` 25, the genre section 1 and the region section 1, `footer` 1. The ad and app-banner rules matched nothing; `iframe[name="googlefcPresent"]` (Google Funding Choices) exists but is an invisible iframe.

Choices: Station logos Show/Blur/Hide.

Streema is Tailwind-styled, so rules use data-testid, ids, hrefs and the `section:has(...)` structure instead of classes.

NOT verified: station and genre pages, the radio player, logged-in pages, ad slots shown on station pages (none appeared on the home page), other languages (the aria-label text of the cookie banner is not used by any rule).
